args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service started failing health checks (healthy=false, error rate 18%) in us-east, us-west and eu-west. v2.3.1-rc had also been marked unhealthy in staging. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy and the error rate is 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before trying to deploy it again.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's passing health checks again. I also opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2) for checkout-api, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate had also failed in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production. After the rollback, all three regions run v2.3.0 and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The summary covers the failure, the rollback and the result. As a next step, it says to find the cause of the v2.3.1 failure before deploying it again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
